newsitem.title: FRANCE: Alcatel has no comment on new Thomson bid report.
newsitem.headline: Alcatel has no comment on new Thomson bid report.

text.p: Alcatel-Alsthom declined to comment on Tuesday on a report that it might bid again for Thomson SA if the planned sale of the French electronics group to Lagardere Groupe did not go through by the December 31 deadline.
"We are making no comment," an Alcatel spokesman said.
The French newspaper Liberation reported chairman Serge Tchuruk had said he "would make a new offer that would take into account developments that have taken place since" his initial offer.
The newspaper quoted in its report from national assembly committee minutes dated October 26.
Alcatel put in a rival bid for Thomson. But the centre-right government in October announced it favoured a takeover offer from Lagardere for Thomson.

The government plans to recapitalise Thomson with 11 billion francs before selling it to Lagardere for one franc. Lagardere, in turn, plans to sell Thomson's consumer electronics business Thomson Multimedia (TMM) to Daewoo Electronics for one franc.
